method: CUA actual browser UI flows; manually observed, not an unattended regression script

checks.name: US CV launches fighter, bomber and torpedo squadrons labelled by category and surviving count
UK CVL launches three-aircraft squadrons with three owner turns of endurance
First owner turn ending reduces CV/CVL endurance to 3/2; other player turn does not reduce it again
Realtime elapsed while inspecting and documenting does not consume endurance
Selected squadron title uses category-count; model and country remain in details
Final remaining turn automatically sets CVL squadrons to return
Two returning CVL squadrons recover to their mother; active squadron count changes from 5 to 3
Both friendly and enemy ship names have health bars and HP values beneath them
Artillery damage updates enemy Lafey bar to half and HP from 6 to 3
Handover to target owner confirms Lafey HP 3/6 in the ship UI
Camera dragging preserves ship-name and health-bar alignment
Moving Lafey from 12,20 to 13,20 keeps her name and health bar attached; oil decreases by one
No browser console errors observed after gameplay checks

limits: Large aircraft-count performance and full-match balance were not tested.
